## 7. Interpretation boundaries

- String searches for !important are indicators; priority may be represented by flags or masks instead of retained text.
- Selector weight names are not mapped to CSS specificity unless enum/constants and dispatch logic establish that mapping.
- File insertion order is not automatically final cascade order; follow parser insertion, selector grouping and property merge.
- Font declarations and embedded-font loading are distinct paths.
- Missing matches in partial decode do not prove absence.
